gaps.sentence: He behaves as if he were ___ owner of the company.
gaps.explanation: 'The owner' — there is one owner, so 'the'.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ best film of the decade by common consent.
___ Alps attract skiers from all over the world.
gaps.explanation: Mountain ranges take 'the' (the Alps), but single peaks take no article (Everest).

gaps.sentence: He was wearing ___ strange metal bracelet on his left wrist.
gaps.explanation: 'A strange bracelet' (first mention); body parts after prepositions traditionally take 'the' (on the left wrist).

gaps.sentence: He was born in ___ Netherlands, not in Belgium.
gaps.explanation: Country names that are plural or contain 'Kingdom/Republic/States' take 'the': the Netherlands.

gaps.sentence: She earns fifty pounds ___ hour as a consultant.
gaps.explanation: 'An hour' — the 'h' is silent, so it starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: He is ___ most experienced teacher in the school.
gaps.explanation: Superlative + of/in-phrase: the most experienced teacher in the school.

gaps.sentence: The patient needs ___ operation as soon as possible.
gaps.explanation: 'An operation' — 'operation' starts with a vowel sound.
